Messages will be sent when an option is halted, is released for quotation, released for trading, or temporarily suspended for trading on the buy or sell side.

Message.Name: Security Open Message
Message.Description: NASDAQ plans to disseminate the Option Open Message for each option as soon as the opening is completed. Upon receipt of the open state message, firms should be advised that the option denoted in the message is now available for auto execution within the NASDAQ Options Market System. Upon receipt of the closed state message, firms should be advised that the option is no longer eligible for auto-execution within the NASDAQ Options Market System.

Message.Name: Single side executed message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever a Side order is executed in whole or in part. It is possible to receive several Single Side Executed Messages for the same Side order if that Side order is executed in several parts. The multiple Single Side Executed Messages on the same order are cumulative. By combining the executions received separately via two types of Single Side Executed Messages and Trade Messages, it is possible to build a complete view of all non-auction executions that happen on NASDAQ. Auction execution information is available in one bulk print via the Auction Trade Message.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq Internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: Reference Number
Field.Description: The order/quote reference number associated with the executed order.

Field.Name: Executed Contracts
Field.Description: The number of contracts executed.

Field.Name: Cross Number
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Execution Id. Identifies the component of an execution. Unique for a given day. The match number is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Message.Name: Single Side Executed With Price Message
Message.Description: These executions may be marked as non-printable. If the execution is marked as non-printed, it means that the contracts will be included into a later bulk print (e.g., in the case of auction executions). If a firm is looking to use the ITTO data in time-and-sales displays or volume calculations, NASDAQ recommends that firms ignore messages marked as non-printable to prevent double counting.

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: Start of Messages. This is always the first message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Start of System Hours
Value.Description: Start of System Hours. This message indicates that NASDAQ is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: Start of Opening Process
Value.Description: Start of Opening Process. This message is intended to indicate that NASDAQ has started its opening auction process.

Value.Name: End of Normal Hours Processing
Value.Description: End of Normal Hours Processing - This message is intended to indicate that NASDAQ will no longer accept any new orders or changes to existing orders for options that trade during normal trading hours.

Value.Name: End of Late Hours Processing
Value.Description: End of Late Hours Processing - This message is intended to indicate that NASDAQ will no longer accept any new orders or changes to existing orders for options that trade during extended hours.

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: End of System Hours. This message indicates that NASDAQ options system is now closed.

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: End of Messages. This is always the last message sent in any trading day.
